title: Play with friends
subtitle: Host a private server on this PC. Friends join from JKNet without port forwarding.

noClient.title: No client can host a server
noClient.text: Create an OpenJK, EternalJK or TaystJK client to host a game.

client.label: Client
client.hint: The server runs this client's engine, mod and files.
client.blockedNoDedicated: {{engine}} has no dedicated server. Pick another client.
client.blockedEngineMissing: The dedicated server of {{engine}} is missing. Reinstall the engine on the Clients screen.

map.label: Map
map.none: This client has no map for this game type.

bots.label: Bots
bots.hint: Bots fill empty slots until this many players are in.

password.label: Password
password.hint: Friends from JKNet get it with the invite.

internet_lan.title: Internet and local network
internet_lan.text: Friends anywhere join through the JKNet relay. Players on your network connect directly.

lan.title: Local network only
lan.text: Only players on your network can join. Nothing goes through the relay.

internet.title: Internet only
internet.text: Everyone joins through the JKNet relay. Windows does not ask about the firewall.

setup.firewall: Windows may ask whether the {{engine}} server can use your network. Choose Allow so players on your network can join.

signIn.text: Sign in to JKNet Online to let friends join over the internet. Local network play works without an account.

relayDown.text: The JKNet relay is not available: {{reason}}. Players on your network can still join.
relayDown.quotaActive: You already use the relay for another server. Players on your network can still join.
relayDown.quotaDaily: Your relay time for today is used up. It resets at {{time}}. Players on your network can still join.

relayReason.unavailable: it is busy or switched off
relayReason.node_silent: no answer from the relay in 10 seconds
relayReason.rate_limited: too many requests, try again in a minute
relayReason.signed_out: you are signed out of JKNet Online
relayReason.network: JKNet Online is out of reach

autoStop.empty: Stops in {{time}}: the server is empty.

join.title: How friends join
join.consoleHint: Players without JKNet: open the console with Shift+~ and paste the command.

changeMap.title: Change map
changeMap.text: Players stay connected while the server loads the new map.

reason.empty: Stopped after {{minutes}} min with no players.
reason.launcher_exit: JKNet closed and stopped the server.

failed.exited: The server closed during startup (exit code {{code}}).
failed.timeout: The server did not load {{map}} in 30 seconds.
failed.portsBusy: No free port between {{from}} and {{to}}. Stop other servers on this PC and try again.
failed.mapMissing: The server did not find the map {{map}}. Pick another map.
failed.other: The server stopped with an error.
failed.logEmpty: The server printed nothing before it closed.
failed.logLabel: Last lines of the server log

panel.title: Invite friends
panel.caption: Friends you mark here get an invite when the server is ready.
panel.noFriends: Add friends on the Friends screen to invite them here.
panel.relayNeeded: Friends outside your network can't join until the relay connects.
panel.markFriend: Invite {{name}} when the server is ready

policy.label: Who can join without an invite
policy.hint: Friends who can join get the password and see Join game while the server runs.
policy.noFriends: You have no friends to choose yet.

idle.title: Play with friends
idle.text: Host a private server on this PC and invite friends. No port forwarding.

friends.hostAndInviteHint: Start a private server and invite {{name}}
friends.notReady: Your server is still starting. Invite once it runs.

join.probeFailed: {{name}}'s server did not answer on your network. The game will keep trying.

quit.title: Stop your server and quit?
quit.text_one: {{count}} player is on your server. Closing JKNet stops it.
quit.text_other: {{count}} players are on your server. Closing JKNet stops it.

update.blocked: Stop your server to install the update.
